CustomField.description: End of the qualification period (Jun 30 or Dec 31) for this attempt.
CustomField.formula: IF( MONTH( BLANKVALUE(Attempt_Date__c, FIR_Qualification_Form__r.Test_Date__c) ) <= 6, DATE( YEAR( BLANKVALUE(Attempt_Date__c, FIR_Qualification_Form__r.Test_Date__c) ), 6, 30), DATE( YEAR( BLANKVALUE(Attempt_Date__c, FIR_Qualification_Form__r.Test_Date__c) ), 12, 31) )
CustomField.label: Period End
